note: MADE-UP DATA WALK, NOT A RESULT. Everything in this folder is scratch. It holds made-up passages, labels, questions, solver answers, notes, verdicts, receipts and a made-up status table. It holds no real passage and no evidence about roles. No outside service and no AWS service was called. The whole folder may be deleted.
what_was_walked: The eleven laptop tools tools/ob_*.py, as byte copies, in a scratch copy of the study folder (project/). They ran as real runs, not as dry-fixture runs: no --work, the real seal checks, the real floors and targets. guard_run.py put made-up replies in the place of the outside services and made every socket connection fail.

folders.project/: the walk: eligibility to seal step 6 on 144 made-up passages. Its PLAN_CONSTANTS.json is the real file with the keys of CONSTANTS_CHANGES.json changed (pins and counts of the made-up source files, the made-up settings).
folders.project_probe/: a side copy for probes: the DeepSeek token limits, a reply with no model name, a changed tool, the tool-repair window, an answer sheet with a sign that cp1252 can not print.
folders.project_dev/: a byte copy of the programs with the REAL constants, in which a byte copy of optionb/dry/build_dev_package.py ran with --stop-before-the-builders. The two controller builders were not run.
folders.step7_probe/: made-up receipts, a made-up selftest.json and two small zips for dry runs of seal step 7.
folders.logs/: what every command printed, with its exit code. stub_calls.jsonl lists every made-up service call.

scripts.00_make_project_copy.py: copies programs and rule texts, byte for byte
scripts.01_make_fixture.py: writes the made-up source files and the scratch constants
scripts.walk_fixture.py: the made-up people, passages, questions and notes
scripts.walk_stub.py: the stand-in for the outside services
scripts.guard_run.py: runs one tool unchanged with the stand-in and with the network closed
scripts.run.sh: runs one tool through guard_run.py and keeps its output under logs/
scripts.claude_stand_in.py: writes a made-up answer sheet in the place of a Claude sub-agent
scripts.02_make_step7_probe.py: made-up files for dry runs of seal step 7
scripts.check_formats.py: compares the written files with field lists typed from FILE_FORMATS.md
scripts.shape.py: prints the shape of a JSON file
